title: ePoS Machine in Public Distribution System

facts.summary: An Electronic Point of Sale (ePoS) device is used at Fair Price Shops to support electronic authentication and recording of ration distribution transactions under the Public Distribution System.
purpose: Authenticate beneficiaries during ration distribution where the applicable system requires authentication.
Support transparency and monitoring of PDS transactions.
Maintain an electronic record of distribution at the Fair Price Shop.
facts.location: ePoS devices are generally operated at designated Fair Price Shops or authorized PDS distribution outlets where the applicable State or Union Territory system uses them.
facts.authentication: The applicable ePoS system may use Aadhaar-based authentication, biometric authentication, OTP or another authorized verification mechanism depending on the applicable State/UT implementation.
facts.transaction: When ration is distributed through an ePoS-enabled Fair Price Shop, the distribution transaction can be recorded electronically in the applicable PDS system.
facts.beneficiary_verification: The ePoS system can assist with beneficiary identification and authentication before recording a distribution transaction, subject to the authentication method implemented by the concerned State/UT.
facts.failure_or_issue: If an ePoS device or authentication process fails, the beneficiary should follow the applicable State/UT procedure for resolving authentication or transaction issues.
facts.privacy: Beneficiaries should use only authorized government PDS systems and should not share OTPs, authentication credentials or other sensitive information with unauthorized persons.
facts.state_specific: The exact ePoS workflow, authentication mechanism and procedures for handling failed transactions can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: ePoS stands for Electronic Point of Sale.
An ePoS device is used to electronically support PDS distribution transactions.
The exact authentication method depends on the applicable State/UT implementation.
A failed authentication or ePoS transaction does not by itself establish that a beneficiary is ineligible for ration.
Do not assume that every Fair Price Shop uses an identical ePoS workflow.
Use the official State/UT PDS grievance or assistance mechanism for unresolved ePoS issues.

faqs.question: What is an ePoS machine?
faqs.answer: An ePoS machine is an Electronic Point of Sale device used at applicable Fair Price Shops to support beneficiary authentication and electronically record ration distribution transactions.

faqs.question: Why is an ePoS machine used in ration shops?
faqs.answer: It is used to support beneficiary authentication and electronic recording of ration distribution transactions.

faqs.question: How does the ePoS machine verify a beneficiary?
faqs.answer: The authentication method depends on the State/UT system and may include Aadhaar-based or biometric authentication, OTP or another authorized verification method.

faqs.question: What happens if the ePoS machine does not work?
faqs.answer: Follow the applicable State/UT procedure for resolving ePoS or authentication issues and contact the designated PDS authority or Fair Price Shop when necessary.

faqs.question: Does ePoS record my ration transaction?
faqs.answer: Where an ePoS-enabled system is used, the ration distribution transaction can be recorded electronically in the applicable PDS system.

faqs.question: Is ePoS mandatory at every ration shop?
faqs.answer: The use and implementation of ePoS systems depend on the applicable PDS arrangements of the concerned State or Union Territory.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
